targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT ServiceName) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE
SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'queueSize' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT sum(Value) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT round(sum(Value) / 1048576, 0) as value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT round(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) * 100, 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName = 'spark-master' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT round(avg(Value) * 100, 2) as value FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') * 100, 2) as `spark-master`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') * 100, 2) as `spark-worker-1`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') * 100, 2) as `spark-worker-2`, round(avgIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') * 100, 2) as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.cpu.recent_utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-master`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-worker-1`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-worker-2`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') / 1073741824, 3) as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, MetricName='jvm.memory.used') / 1048576, 0) as `heap-used-mb`, round(sumIf(Value, MetricName='jvm.memory.committed') / 1048576, 0) as `heap-committed-mb` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-worker%' AND MetricName IN ('jvm.memory.used','jvm.memory.committed') AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') as `spark-master`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `spark-worker-1`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `spark-worker-2`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.thread.count' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') / 1048576, 2) as `spark-master`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') / 1048576, 2) as `spark-worker-1`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') / 1048576, 2) as `spark-worker-2`, round(sumIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') / 1048576, 2) as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used_after_last_gc' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-master') as `spark-master`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-1') as `spark-worker-1`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-2') as `spark-worker-2`, maxIf(Value, ServiceName='spark-worker-3') as `spark-worker-3` FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'queueSize' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(TimeUnix) as time, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name'] = 'G1 Eden Space') / 1048576, 2) as `G1-Eden`, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name'] = 'G1 Survivor Space') / 1048576, 2) as `G1-Survivor`, round(avgIf(Value, Attributes['jvm.memory.pool.name'] = 'G1 Old Gen') / 1048576, 2) as `G1-Old` FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND MetricName = 'jvm.memory.used' AND Attributes['jvm.memory.type'] = 'heap' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT Timestamp as timestamp, Body as body, SeverityText as level, ServiceName FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName LIKE 'spark-%' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 200
